title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the viewport for secondary tasks such as filters or details. Behaves like a modal: focus trap, Escape, backdrop click and focus return.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state (`v-model:open`); leave `undefined` for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state while uncontrolled

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the panel slides in from

props.name: size
props.description: Size preset

props.name: title
props.description: Title rendered as the drawer's accessible name (or the `title` slot).

props.name: description
props.description: Description rendered below the title (or the `description` slot).

props.name: hideCloseButton
props.description: Hides the close (×) button

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close button; defaults to the localized "Close".

props.name: hiddenDescription
props.description:
Text of the visually hidden description rendered when `description` is
not set; defaults to the localized "Drawer content".

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Element opening the drawer (its single child gets the trigger props)

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges the behaviour onto the single child element instead of rendering a `<button>`

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA role of the panel

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keeps the panel mounted while closed (`data-state="closed"`), e.g. for

Modal mode: renders the overlay, traps focus, locks page scrolling and
blocks / hides the page behind. Non-modal drawers close on outside click /
focus instead.

vars.name: --drawer-width
vars.description: Width of a left / right drawer (every size; defaults to the width of the size)

vars.name: --drawer-height
vars.description: Height of a top / bottom drawer (every size; defaults to the height of the size)

vars.name: --drawer-padding
vars.description: Horizontal padding of the header, description, body and footer

vars.description: Corner radius of the inner edge (defaults to --radius-lg)

vars.name: --drawer-z-index
vars.description: Stacking order of the panel (defaults to --z-modal)

translationResources.title: Drawer
translationResources.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the viewport for secondary tasks such as filters or details. Behaves like a modal: focus trap, Escape, backdrop click and focus return.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Controlled with open and onOpenChange, with a body and an action footer.

sides.title: Sides and sizes
sides.description: side picks the edge; size sets the width (left / right) or the height (top / bottom).

compound.title: Compound API
compound.description: DrawerRoot, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerBody, DrawerFooter and DrawerClose.

DrawerProps.open: Controlled open state; leave undefined for uncontrolled
DrawerProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (trigger, close button, Escape, backdrop click)
DrawerProps.trigger: Element that opens it on click (single element, rendered with asChild)
DrawerProps.side: Edge the panel slides in from
DrawerProps.size: Size preset: width for left / right, height for top / bottom
DrawerProps.title: Title, used as the dialog's accessible name
DrawerProps.description: Description below the title, used as the accessible description
DrawerProps.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close button; defaults to the localized "Close"
DrawerProps.hiddenDescription: Text of the visually hidden description used when description is not set; defaults to the localized "Drawer content"
DrawerProps.className: Additional class name of the panel

DrawerRootProps.open: Controlled open state; leave undefined for uncontrolled
DrawerRootProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (trigger, close button, Escape, backdrop click)
DrawerRootProps.modal: Modal mode: renders the backdrop, traps focus, locks page scrolling, blocks outside interaction and hides the page from assistive technology

DrawerContentProps.side: Edge the panel slides in from
DrawerContentProps.size: Size preset: width for left / right, height for top / bottom
DrawerContentProps.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close button; defaults to the localized "Close"
DrawerContentProps.hiddenDescription: Text of the visually hidden description used when description is not set; defaults to the localized "Drawer content"
DrawerContentProps.description: Visible description below the title; without it a hidden generic description is rendered
DrawerContentProps.role: ARIA role of the panel; use "alertdialog" for confirmations that interrupt the user
DrawerContentProps.forceMount: Keeps the panel mounted while closed (data-state="closed"), e.g. for animation libraries
DrawerContentProps.onOpenAutoFocus: Called before focus moves into the panel on open; event.preventDefault() keeps focus where it is
DrawerContentProps.onCloseAutoFocus: Called before focus returns to the opener on close; event.preventDefault() skips it
DrawerContentProps.onEscapeKeyDown: Escape pressed while it is the topmost layer; event.preventDefault() keeps it open
DrawerContentProps.onPointerDownOutside: Pointer pressed outside; event.preventDefault() keeps it open
DrawerContentProps.onInteractOutside: Pointer down or focus outside; event.preventDefault() keeps it open

cssVars.--drawer-width: Width of a left / right drawer (every size; defaults to the width of the size)
cssVars.--drawer-height: Height of a top / bottom drawer (every size; defaults to the height of the size)
cssVars.--drawer-padding: Horizontal padding of the header, description, body and footer
cssVars.--drawer-radius: Corner radius of the inner edge (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--drawer-z-index: Stacking order of the panel (defaults to --z-modal)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A side panel opened by its trigger slot. Any light DOM element with data-drawer-close (here the footer buttons) closes it.

sides.title: Sides
sides.description: side picks the edge the drawer slides in from; size is a width for left / right drawers and a height for top / bottom ones.

non-modal.title: Non-modal
non-modal.description: With non-modal the page stays interactive: no overlay, no focus trap, and an outside click closes the drawer. minerva-open-change reports the reason.

props.label: Title text (or use the header slot); names the dialog.
props.nonModal: Non-modal: no overlay, no focus trap, no scroll lock; closes on outside pointer down / focus.

events.minerva-open-change: The user asked to open / close (detail: { open, reason }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
events.minerva-after-open: Fired once the panel is open and focus has moved in.
events.minerva-after-close: Fired once the panel has finished closing (after its exit animation).

slots.trigger: Element that opens the panel when clicked.

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: Interact with the native component in this phone preview.

native.limitations: Native Drawer and DrawerContent default to a bottom sheet. Set side or placement for left, right or top panels. Content uses native Views and Text.
